accepted_findings: Fixed-radius L=2 angular snapshots are a coherent successor to the local weak-density validation; they are not a radial-operator export.
The round lambda ell=0 potential density is -2FG-r(FGprime+FprimeG), with radial flux rFG.
The constant-harmonic lapse density is -r fprime G, with radial flux r f G.
Tensor jets must retain symbolic radial differentiation before exact radius substitution.
Same-m assembled scalar integrands should be rational in x; denominator pole exclusion must follow exact cancellation.
Potential bulk Hermiticity is independent of the separate radial Green flux; rectangular lapse blocks have no Hermiticity requirement.
Positive-sine realification needs a direct real-field azimuthal average, not a self-comparison of the realification formula.
remaining_before_execution: Obtain explicit per-run user approval before any scientific launch.
resource_interpretation: The 300-second cap bounds a first diagnostic; no end-to-end completion time has been measured or promised.
